name: Tau Ceti
tagline: A quiet Sun-like star 12 light-years away with a crowded inner system.
history: Tau Ceti is the nearest single Sun-like star — slightly cooler and older than our Sun, and unusually metal-poor and magnetically quiet. Radial-velocity surveys find up to five candidate planets, two near the habitable zone, all unconfirmed. Its massive debris disk throws ten times more comets at its inner system than ours did — a rough neighborhood for any young Earths. Like Epsilon Eridani, it was a founding target of 1960s SETI.
